license_required.quote: No person who is not certified or registered shall engage in the business of contracting in this state.

issuing_authority.quote: There is created in the department the Electrical Contractors' Licensing Board.

name.quote: There is created in the department the Electrical Contractors' Licensing Board.

type.quote: The board shall consist of 11 members, 7 of whom shall be certified electrical contractors, 2 of whom shall be consumer members who are not, and have never been, electrical contractors or members of any closely related profession or occupation, and 2 of whom shall be certified alarm system contractors I.

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Business and Professional Regulation
umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the Department of Business and Professional Regulation.

age_minimum.quote: Any person who is at least 18 years of age may take the certification examination.

required.quote: Has, within the 6 years immediately preceding the filing of the application, at least 3 years of proven management experience in the trade or education equivalent thereto

experience_source.quote: Has, within the 6 years immediately preceding the filing of the application, at least 3 years of proven management experience in the trade or education equivalent thereto, or a combination thereof, but not more than one-half of such experience may be educational equivalent

duration.value: 3 years (management experience pathway) or 4 years (supervisor/contractor pathway) or 6 years (comprehensive training pathway)
duration.quote: Has, within the 6 years immediately preceding the filing of the application, at least 3 years of proven management experience in the trade or education equivalent thereto, or a combination thereof

kind.value: management experience, supervisory experience, or comprehensive training in electrical or alarm system contracting
kind.quote: at least 3 years of proven management experience in the trade or education equivalent thereto, or a combination thereof

exams.name: Electrical Contractor Certification Examination
exams.notes: Board may limit attempts; after three unsuccessful attempts may require additional college-level or technical education courses.
exams.quote: To establish competency, a person shall pass the appropriate examination administered by the department.

interval_years.quote: The department shall adopt rules establishing a procedure for the biennial renewal of certificates and registrations.

required.quote: Each certificateholder or registrant licensed as an electrical contractor shall provide proof, in a form established by rule of the board, that the certificateholder or registrant has completed at least 11 classroom hours of at least 50 minutes each of continuing education courses during each biennium

hours_per_period.quote: at least 11 classroom hours of at least 50 minutes each of continuing education courses during each biennium

period_years.quote: at least 11 classroom hours of at least 50 minutes each of continuing education courses during each biennium

value: at least 7 hours on technical subjects
1 hour on workers' compensation
1 hour on workplace safety
1 hour on business practices
2 hours on false alarm prevention (for electrical contractors engaged in alarm system contracting)
topical_requirements.quote: of the minimum 11 classroom hours of continuing education required, at least 7 hours must be on technical subjects, 1 hour on workers' compensation, 1 hour on workplace safety, and 1 hour on business practices. Electrical contractors engaged in alarm system contracting must also complete 2 hours on false alarm prevention.

available.quote: The board shall certify as qualified for certification by endorsement any individual applying for certification who: (a) Meets the requirements for certification as set forth in this section; has passed a national, regional, state, or United States territorial licensing examination that is substantially equivalent to the examination required by this part

requirements.value: Applicant must meet FL certification requirements and have passed a substantially equivalent exam from another state/territory, OR hold a valid license from another state with substantially equivalent criteria, OR have held a valid license from another state for at least 10 years. Must also complete a 2-hour course on the Florida Building Code.
requirements.quote: Holds a valid license to practice electrical or alarm system contracting issued by another state or territory of the United States, if the criteria for issuance of such license were substantially equivalent to the certification criteria that existed in this state at the time the certificate was issued

exists.quote: There is created in the department the Electrical Contractors' Licensing Board. The board shall consist of 11 members, 7 of whom shall be certified electrical contractors

regulatory_model.quote: No person who is not certified or registered shall engage in the business of contracting in this state.

credential_type.quote: "Certified electrical contractor" means an electrical contractor who possesses a certificate of competency issued by the department.

is_mandatory.quote: No person who is not certified or registered shall engage in the business of contracting in this state.

title_protection.quote: Use the name or title "electrical contractor" or "alarm system contractor" or words to that effect, or advertise himself or herself or a business organization as available to practice electrical or alarm system contracting, when the person is not then the holder of a valid certification or registration issued pursuant to this part

scope_protection.quote: A person may not: (a) Practice contracting unless the person is certified or registered;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with any provision of chapter 455.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with any provision of chapter 455.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to procure a certificate or registration by bribery or fraudulent or willful misrepresentations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to procure a certificate or registration to practice electrical or alarm system contracting by bribery or fraudulent or willful misrepresentations.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a certificate or registration revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against by the licensing authority of another state, territory, or country.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a certificate or registration to practice contracting revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including the denial of licensure, by the licensing authority of another state, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted or found guilty of, or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, a crime that directly relates to the practice of electrical or alarm system contracting.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of, or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of electrical or alarm system contracting or the ability to practice electrical or alarm system contracting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a report or record known to be false, or willfully failing to file a required report.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report or record which the certificateholder or registrant knows to be false, willfully failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law, willfully impeding or obstructing such filing, or inducing another person to impede or obstruct such filing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing fraud, deceit, negligence, incompetency, or misconduct in the practice of electrical or alarm system contracting.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing fraud or deceit, or negligence, incompetency, or misconduct in the practice of electrical or alarm system contracting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating chapter 633 or the rules of the State Fire Marshal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating chapter 633 or the rules of the State Fire Marshal.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing on a revoked, suspended, inactive, or delinquent certificate or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing on a revoked, suspended, inactive, or delinquent certificate or registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the applicable building codes or laws of the state or any municipality or county.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the applicable building codes or laws of the state or any municipality or county thereof.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any act which assists a person or entity in engaging in the prohibited uncertified and unregistered practice of contracting.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any act which assists a person or entity in engaging in the prohibited uncertified and unregistered practice of contracting, if the certificateholder or registrant knows or has reasonable grounds to know that the person or entity was uncertified and unregistered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly combining or conspiring with any person by allowing one's certificate to be used by any uncertified person with intent to evade the provisions of this part.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly combining or conspiring with any person by allowing one's certificate to be used by any uncertified person with intent to evade the provisions of this part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under any certificate or registration except in the name of the certificateholder or registrant as set forth on the issued certificate.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under any certificate or registration issued hereunder except in the name of the certificateholder or registrant as set forth on the issued certificate or registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing financial mismanagement or misconduct in the practice of contracting that causes financial harm to a customer.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing financial mismanagement or misconduct in the practice of contracting that causes financial harm to a customer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being disciplined by any municipality or county for an act that is a violation of this section.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being disciplined by any municipality or county for an act that is a violation of this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing in any material respect to comply with the provisions of this part and the rules adopted pursuant thereto.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing in any material respect to comply with the provisions of this part and the rules adopted pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning a project which the contractor is engaged in or is under contractual obligation to perform.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandoning a project which the contractor is engaged in or is under contractual obligation to perform. A project is to be considered abandoned after 90 days if the contractor terminates the project without just cause

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to affix a registration or certification number as required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to affix a registration or certification number as required by s. 489.521(7).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Proceeding on any job without obtaining applicable local building department permits and inspections.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Proceeding on any job without obtaining applicable local building department permits and inspections.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing beyond the scope of a certification or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing beyond the scope of a certification or registration.

bonding_required.quote: To require one bond for each electrical contractor in an amount not to exceed $5,000, which bond shall be conditioned only upon compliance with the Florida Building Code adopted pursuant to s. 553.73.

insurance_required.quote: the applicant shall submit an affidavit on a form provided by the board attesting to the fact that the applicant has obtained both workers' compensation insurance or an acceptable exemption certificate issued by the department and public liability and property damage insurance for the health, safety, and welfare of the public in amounts determined by rule of the board

definition_quote.value: "Electrical contractor" or "unlimited electrical contractor" means a person who conducts business in the electrical trade field and who has the experience, knowledge, and skill to install, repair, alter, add to, or design, in compliance with law, electrical wiring, fixtures, appliances, apparatus, raceways, conduit, or any part thereof, which generates, transmits, transforms, or utilizes electrical energy in any form, including the electrical installations and systems within plants and substations, all in compliance with applicable plans, specifications, codes, laws, and regulations.
definition_quote.quote: "Electrical contractor" or "unlimited electrical contractor" means a person who conducts business in the electrical trade field and who has the experience, knowledge, and skill to install, repair, alter, add to, or design, in compliance with law, electrical wiring, fixtures, appliances, apparatus, raceways, conduit, or any part thereof, which generates, transmits, transforms, or utilizes electrical energy in any form, including the electrical installations and systems within plants and substations, all in compliance with applicable plans, specifications, codes, laws, and regulations.

qualifier_required.quote: At least one officer or supervising employee of the business organization must be qualified under this act in order for the business organization to be qualified to engage in contracting in the category of the business conducted.

value: Electrical contractor business: qualifying agent must hold certificate of competency as electrical contractor
Alarm system contractor business: qualifying agent must hold certificate of competency in matching alarm system contractor category
qualifier_license_requirement_by_contrac.quote: the proposed qualifying agent is legally qualified to act for the business organization in all matters connected with its electrical or alarm system contracting business

qualifier_replacement_notice_days.quote: If any individual so qualified on behalf of the business organization ceases to qualify the business organization, he or she shall notify the board and the department thereof within 30 days after such occurrence.

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: the business organization shall notify the board and the department of the individual's termination, and it shall have a period of 60 days from the termination of the individual to qualify another person under the provision of this act

journeyman_electrician_apprenticeship_ho.quote: Has completed a registered and state-approved apprenticeship program as defined in s. 446.021(6) or has at least 12,000 hours of on-the-job training in his or her specific trade

expedited_licensure_pathway_available.quote: Has held a valid, current license to practice electrical or alarm system contracting issued by another state or territory of the United States for at least 10 years before the date of application and is applying for the same or similar license in this state

electrician_continuing_education_hours.quote: at least 11 classroom hours of at least 50 minutes each of continuing education courses during each biennium

national_electrical_code_reference.quote: The scope of certification is limited to alarm circuits originating in the alarm control panel and equipment governed by the applicable provisions of Articles 722, 725, 760, 770, 800, and 810 of the National Electrical Code, Current Edition

small_project_dollar_threshold_exemption.quote: Any work or operation of a casual, minor, or inconsequential nature in which the aggregate contract price for labor, materials, and all other items is less than $2,500

solar_panel_electrical_work_exemption.quote: an owner must utilize a licensed electrical contractor to effectuate the wiring of the solar panels, including any interconnection to the customer's residential electrical wiring.

utility_worker_exemption.quote: Public utilities, on construction, maintenance, and development work performed by their forces and incidental to their business.

workers_compensation_insurance_required.quote: any person, business organization, or qualifying agent engaged in the business of contracting in this state and certified or registered under this part shall, as a condition precedent to the issuance or renewal of a certificate or registration of the contractor, provide to the Electrical Contractors' Licensing Board, as provided by board rule, evidence of workers' compensation coverage pursuant to chapter 440.

public_liability_insurance_required.quote: the applicant shall submit an affidavit on a form provided by the board attesting to the fact that the applicant has obtained both workers' compensation insurance or an acceptable exemption certificate issued by the department and public liability and property damage insurance for the health, safety, and welfare of the public in amounts determined by rule of the board
